pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregular polygonal patches with high-contrast, relatively sharp pixel gradients at the boundaries. Vertices are generally rounded rather than acute, and patches maintain a high spatial area relative to the inter-patch space.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of off-white inter-patch pathways forming a topological grid. Junction nodes are predominantly Y-shaped (tri-radial) and X-shaped (quad-radial), with a consistent pixel thickness across the flank that narrows slightly toward the neck.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Short, erect mane exhibiting a high-frequency, low-amplitude serrated contour against the background. The silhouette consists of individual hair-bundle peaks with shallow, regular troughs.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: A single, small, dark-pigmented nodular textural disruption is visible on the upper dorsal-lateral region near the shoulder-neck junction.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant, localized pendulous mass or focal swelling is visible on the ventral-cervical region (brisket area) anterior to the forelimb, partially occluded by foreground vegetation.
